name: The Brand Essence Wheel
diagnostic: When outer technical facts and user benefits are distilled inward, what two-to-three word essence captures the central promise of the brand?
artifact: A 5-Ring Concentric Essence Wheel moving inward from Physical Attributes & Facts to Functional Benefits, Emotional Payoffs, Personality Archetypes, and the central Brand Essence.
trap: Choosing an interchangeable abstraction for the essence — Trust, Innovation, Quality — which carries zero competitive tension.

origin.line: Bates Worldwide / Richard Macrae & Robin Wensley (1990s)

pedigreeFull: Bates Worldwide / Richard Macrae & Robin Wensley (1990s). An advertising agency framework designed to distill multifaceted product offerings down into an unambiguous emotional and functional core.
artifactFull: A 5-Ring Concentric Essence Wheel moving inward from Physical Attributes & Facts to Functional Benefits, Emotional Payoffs, Personality Archetypes, and the central Brand Essence.
trapFull: Selecting an interchangeable corporate abstraction for the core essence (such as "Trust," "Innovation," or "Quality") that offers zero competitive tension.
